ratings_why.fun: Every Phial is a real when/who/what-for decision, and one cast can fan out through Spectacle, Old Lady, Alchymist and Pavonia in ways worth planning.
ratings_why.distinct: Lenses and hold-to-Steep are fresh, but a counter of spells cast this game and buff-spells-in-hand read close to Battlegrounds Nagas.

verdict_why: v2 cleared the Echo and Recipe questions; what is left is balance for the owner, not a rules fix.

points.text: Dame Pavonia takes a scaled Echo of every cast, so each Phial 5 adds about half her stats: growth multiplies each turn. Keep it hot, but test her in the two-pass runaway check before the owner balances.
The Old Lady is the only card that cares about multiples of 5. A second payoff that reads the Recipe count (say, a Tier 5 that fires on a multiple) would make counting a whole build, not one card.
Treacle Painter's flat +1/+1 fades late. Letting it give neighbours the Phial's N (unscaled) would keep the early lens alive and pair it with Cocoon's big Phials.

Holding is paid in fights (Circler, Lamplighter, Burnet) and casting is paid in recruiting, which is a great split. One more fight card that spends a held Phial mid-fight would make the hold side visible on screen.
Lamplighter targeting the lowest-Health unit gives a placement trick: park a tiny lens like The Spectacle low so it survives the front row. Worth naming in the builds.

standouts.why: The Spectacle makes a weak cast on a small unit into scaled Echoes on the big ones behind it: aiming and placement become the puzzle.
Cocoon Spinner turns a clogged hand into the route past the cap, and it feeds Burnet, Lamplighter and Elder at once.
Mother Shipton's leftovers serve both poles: Recipe steps, Clerk gold, Burnet damage or Cocoon fuel.

weakest.why: Almanac Seller is a random +1/+1 per cast with no choice in it.
Lamp-Circler is a plain count of Phials; fine early, no interaction after.
The Herald is a dial on Steep; useful but it only adds a number.

flags.note: Scaled Echo on every cast compounds; golden doubles it. Could outgrow any board by mid-game.
With a merged Phial 15-20, Burnet clears much of a board by itself, up to three times a fight.
Alchymist's Echo goes onto the same unit, while the Echo rule says another unit; the card overrides it, but the UI should say so.
